name: Driving without a valid driver's licence
sinhala_name: වලංගු රියදුරු බලපත්‍රයකින් තොරව රිය පැදවීම
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Operating a motor vehicle without holding a valid driving licence for that class.

name: Driving with an expired international driving permit
sinhala_name: කල් ඉකුත් වූ ජාත්‍යන්තර රියදුරු බලපත්‍රයකින් රිය පැදවීම
description: Driving using an international driving permit that has elapsed beyond permitted stay or validity.

name: No L-plate while on a learner permit
sinhala_name: ඉගෙනුම් බලපත්‍රය යටතේ L පුවරුවක් ප්‍රදර්ශනය නොකිරීම
description: Failing to affix standard visible 'L' plates on front and rear when driving under learner permit.

name: Driving without a valid revenue licence
sinhala_name: වලංගු ආදායම් බලපත්‍රයකින් තොරව රිය පැදවීම
description: Operating a motor vehicle without a valid annual revenue licence in force or failing to display.

name: Driving without a valid third-party insurance certificate
sinhala_name: තෙවන පාර්ශ්ව රක්ෂණයකින් තොරව රිය පැදවීම
act: Motor Traffic Act & Insurance Act No. 10 of 2019
description: Operating a motor vehicle without mandatory third-party insurance cover in force.

name: Driving without a valid vehicle emission test certificate
sinhala_name: වලංගු දුම් පරීක්ෂණ සහතිකයකින් තොරව රිය පැදවීම
description: Using motor vehicle without valid vehicle emission certificate or fitness certification.

name: Using a mobile phone while driving
sinhala_name: රිය පැදවීමේදී ජංගම දුරකථනය භාවිතය
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Using a handheld cellular mobile phone or interactive communication device while driving.

name: Driver or front-seat passenger not wearing a seatbelt
sinhala_name: රියදුරු හෝ ඉදිරිපස මගියා ආසන පටි නොපැළඳීම
description: Driver or passenger seated in the front failing to wear standard fitted safety seat belt.

name: Carrying a child under 12 in the front seat
sinhala_name: වයස 12ට අඩු ළමයෙකු ඉදිරිපස ආසනයේ රැගෙන යාම
description: Carrying a child aged under twelve years in front seating without approved restraint.

name: Motorcyclist not wearing a helmet (rider)
sinhala_name: පසුපැදිකරුවෙකු හිස් වැසුම නොපැළඳීම
description: Operating a motorcycle without wearing a protective helmet conforming to SLS standards.

name: Motorcycle pillion passenger not wearing a helmet
sinhala_name: පසුපස මගියා හිස් වැස්ම නොපැළඳීම
description: Allowing a pillion rider to travel on motorcycle without approved protective headgear.

name: Defective tyres, lights, brakes, or horn
sinhala_name: දෝෂ සහිත රෝද, ලයිට්, හෝන් භාවිතය
description: Operating vehicle with bald tyres below tread limit, non-functioning headlamps, brakes or defective horn.

name: Three-wheeler carrying more than 3 adult passengers
sinhala_name: ත්‍රී රෝද රථයකට මගීන් 3කට වඩා ගෙන යාම
description: Overcrowding passenger compartment of three-wheeler beyond 3 adult passengers authorized by law.

name: Tinted glass beyond the legal limit
sinhala_name: නියමිත සීමාවට වඩා කළු වීදුරු
description: Affixing tinted glass, film, curtains or coloured material exceeding light transmittance limits.

name: Overloading a goods vehicle
sinhala_name: භාණ්ඩ රථයක් අධික ලෙස පැටවීම
description: Carrying freight or cargo exceeding the Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW) or axle load thresholds.

name: Failing to obey a traffic signal or sign
sinhala_name: සංඥාවලට අනුකූල නොවීම හෝ රථවාහන නීති කඩකිරීම
description: Passing red light at an automated traffic control signal or disregarding stop/regulatory road signs.

name: Failing to stop at a pedestrian crossing
sinhala_name: පදික මාරුවක් ඉදිරියේ නොනැවතීම
description: Failure to slow down and accord immediate right of way to pedestrians crossing on a zebra crossing.

name: Exceeding the speed limit by up to 10 km/h
sinhala_name: වේග සීමාව 10 km/h දක්වා ඉක්මවා යාම
description: Driving above the posted speed limit by up to 10 km/h in an urban or rural speed zone.

name: Exceeding the speed limit by more than 10 km/h
sinhala_name: වේග සීමාව 10 km/h ඉක්මවා යාම
description: Exceeding the statutory speed limit by greater than 10 km/h up to 20 km/h.

name: Overtaking on the wrong side / dangerous overtaking
sinhala_name: වැරදි පැත්තෙන් හෝ අනතුරුදායක ලෙස ඉස්සර කිරීම
description: Overtaking on the left (near side) without exception, or overtaking over double solid white lines.

name: Failing to give way to an emergency vehicle
sinhala_name: හදිසි සේවා රියකට මාර්ගය ඉඩ නොදීම
description: Failing to immediately pull over to the left and halt upon the approach of an ambulance, fire or police vehicle.

name: Disobeying a police officer's lawful direction
sinhala_name: පොලිස් නිලධාරියෙකුගේ අණට කීකරු නොවීම
description: Disobeying verbal, hand or whistle commands of a police officer directing road traffic.

name: Drunk driving / driving under the influence
sinhala_name: මත්පැන් භාවිතයෙන් රිය පැදවීම
description: Driving under influence of alcohol or narcotics (BAC >= 0.08g/dl). Mandatory court trial and licence suspension.

name: Reckless or negligent driving
sinhala_name: නිරවුල් නොවන නොසැලකිලිමත් ලෙස රිය පැදවීම
description: Driving recklessly or in a manner dangerous to the public. Carries court conviction and endorsement.

name: Unauthorised stopping on an expressway
sinhala_name: අධිවේගී මාර්ගයක අනවසරයෙන් නතර කිරීම
description: Stopping, parking or reversing on expressway carriage lanes or shoulders without mechanical emergency.

name: Parking in a no-parking zone
sinhala_name: නැවැත්වීම තහනම් ස්ථානයක නැවැත්වීම
description: Parking or waiting on yellow lines, clearways, near bus stops, bridge approaches or bend crests.
